A renewed Rocq proof on the head commit confirms the dual-control property still holds exhaustively, and the full CI suite (172 tests, all passing) includes the relevant control tests. The change is properly ticketed, approved by an independent change_approver for the app, tested on the final commit, and touches no protected paths or security-sensitive components. All applicable product and process obligations are satisfied with adequate evidence; the change is accepted.
